insurer_name: HDFC ERGO General Insurance Company Limited
sub_limits_waiting_notes: Group employer/affinity policy with extensive base + optional coverages including indemnity hospitalization, maternity, OPD, daily cash, critical illness, wellness, cashless premium reduction.

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Up to Base Sum Insured per schedule; co-pay/sub-limits per group design.
inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Room rent and category rules per schedule; proportionate deduction on Associated Medical Expenses if higher room chosen (ICU exempt).

maternity_coverage.notes: Optional add-on; 9-month waiting reducible by employer; complications and newborn covered.

newborn_coverage.notes: Newborn from Day 1 when maternity benefit opted.

critical_illness_cover.notes: Optional CI lump-sum benefit; configurable list.

permanent_exclusions: Treatment outside India (unless worldwide cover opted)
notable_exclusions_summary: Modular group health policy enabling employers to configure base + optional coverages. Standard IRDAI exclusions; group sponsor can waive PED waiting and maternity waiting.
